name: OpenVibe.AI

exposure.note: the public API (OpenAI-compatible /v1 and the six operations); its human pages moved to OpenVibe.Exchange on 2026-11-07 and answer 301 there. A run receipt (/runs/:id) and the operator console stay for the person signed in

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the database and dependencies are what ready checks)

drains: housekeeping timer, user-module sync and Network key refresh stopped
open HTTP connections closed (closeAllConnections), then the server
ai.run.* outbox relay stopped after the runs (its send in progress awaited; unsent rows stay for the next start)
shutdown.note: the forced exit after 10 s exits 1

resumes.what: runs left queued or running are marked failed with error_code run.interrupted (announced as ai.run.failed); the caller retries them
unsent ai.run.* events in the outbox (server/events.js) go to OpenVibe.Events once the relay starts

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart (30 s in host.example.json); manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: the schema code only adds (CREATE … IF NOT EXISTS, ADD COLUMN; no DROP, RENAME or table rebuild), which an older release ignores

leases.none: no claims: one process owns its PostgreSQL database (ov_ai); a run is taken with a compare-and-set on its status (queued → running)

notes: Providers, models, routing profiles, versioned prompt templates and workflows, runs, request logs, citations, scoped cache, quotas and audit. Workflow output is a draft/evidence package attributed to workflow + model + run. ai.run.queued|succeeded|failed|cached have payload contracts (v0.30.0, status planned): AI publishes them once its Events client is wired in; it publishes none today. ai.run.create takes ai.run-request@1 and returns ai.run@1. Produces ai.run@1 effort_requested, effort_applied, effort_rung and ladder receipts; consumes ai.effort@1 and ai.run-request@1 effort/ladder metadata. Actor consumes those receipts; AI does not authorize agent tickets.
